fusions.name: Splinter to the Heart
fusions.desc: Slides a hidden splinter into a target at or below 25% of its health, dealing 18 damage and using up every affliction on it to add 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Shed Bark Blades
fusions.desc: Pays 5% of your maximum health to shed edged bark around you, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaving them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Whetted Grain
fusions.desc: You strop your grain to an edge: your damage rises by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Sap on the Edge
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
